card.name: Colons and copyright marks in page footers
card.fires_on: Punctuation or marks that open a footer-style field, such as the colon after a label like Advertencias or Contact, the word Copyright, the © sign, or doi. Also seen at the end of a citation.

modes.label: Colon after a label
modes.description: A colon right after a heading-like label such as a warning or contact line.

modes.label: Copyright marker
modes.description: The word Copyright or the © sign that begins a rights notice.

modes.label: Citation or disclosure detail
modes.description: A doi label or a short word inside a reference or disclosure line.

card.plain: It fires on the small marks that start a label, copyright line or citation detail at the edge of a page.
